data.headline: Uber to invest up to $1.25B in Rivian to help launch robotaxis
data.summary: Uber says it will invest up to $1.25 billion in Rivian Automotive to help launch up to 50,000 robotaxis.  Uber, or its fleet partners, are expected to buy 10,000 fully autonomous Rivian R2 robotaxis, with the option to purchase up to 40,000 more in 2030.  “We’re big believers in Rivian’s approach—designing the vehicle, compute platform, and software stack together, while maintaining end-to-end control of scaled manufacturing and supply in the U.S.," Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi said in a statement.
